ONKAR PUNWATKAR 
EXTC BTech VJTI 2023 
 
Oracle Financial Software Services | FTE Interview | On-
Campus 
 
Oracle conducted the placement drive in the 3 week of August. There 
were total of 3 rounds - Online test, technical interview round 1 and 
Technical Interview round 2. All students of circuit branches with CPI 
greater than 7 were eligible to apply. 
 
Round 1 – Online Test: (1 Hour 45 minutes) 
 
Last year, test was conducted on their platform itself and which comprises 
of MCQ about Quantitative and Aptitude, English Comprehensions, and 
core Computer Science concepts. But in our case, it was conducted on 
Hackerrank platform and pattern of paper was also different. Test 
comprises of 9 questions which includes 6 DSA MCQ, 1 SQL query, 1 
rest API question and 1 coding question. Coding question was quite 
confusing as well as tricky. I was able to do MCQ, SQL query, rest API 
and solved the coding problem partially (3 out 15 test cases). 
 
Round 2 – Technical Interview 1:(around 45-50 mins) 
 
He started with the standard question “Tell me About Yourself.”. After 
that he asked me, do you have any plan for MS (I refused)? Then he also 
asked me (since I was from electronics and Telecommunication branch), 
give me some of areas in telecommunication in which research is going 
on.  
 
Interviewers went through my resume and asked me everything about my 
recent projects. They also cross questioned about the future scope and 
limitations of the projects. As during my internship, I worked on Dyte 
WebRTC integration and storing session recording on AWS server, he

asked me what is cloud? and why is there need of cloud? and how you are 
actually storing recording of session on AWS server. It took almost 3 
minutes to explain whole workflow of application and he was satisfied 
with the answer. 
 
Then As I had Edupoint kind of E-commerce website in my resume and 
since python-flask is used for application backend, so he asked how 
python flask framework works? then he asked me how would I add 
“previous orders facility” (like Amazon, Flipkart Website) in your 
application on the basic current data. He also asked me to explain steps 
used to add payment gateway in your application. 
 
Then He gave me one problem statement wherein I was supposed to create 
web application of Employee which included all details related to 
employee. So, he gave me 5 minutes to draw rough Sketch and 2-3 
minutes later I started explaining how frontend would communicate with 
backend by drawing a simple sketch. 
After that we want to test my SQL knowledge, he asked me very basic 
question  
Write SQL query to create database 
Write SQL query to create table   
 
Note:- Make sure you are confident talking about the content on your 
resume. 
 
Round 2: – Technical Interview 2(around 25-30 minutes) 
 
He started with the standard question “Tell me About Yourself.”. 
Interviewers went through my resume and asked me everything about my 
recent internship. They also cross questioned about the future scope and 
limitations of the projects.  
 
Then he asked me do you have any prior knowledge of Data Structure and 
Algorithms? I said yes. So, he asked me what is Linear Search, Binary

Search and bubble sort. I explained both Linear and binary search in too 
much depth. As soon as I started explaining bubble sort, she interrupted 
me and started saying no need to explain bubble sort.  
Selection Sort Algorithm - GeeksforGeeks 
 
Then she asked me do you have any idea of selection sort. Firstly, I 
explained logic of selection sort then wrote pseudo code of it. She was 
Satisfied with answer and took screenshot of pseudo code. 
  
Then she asked me similarity between C++ and Java. She asked me which 
programming language you would prefer if you want to create application 
backend. I said Python -flask or Django since I was not confident with 
Java.  
Since I did one of my project in PHP and mySQL. so she asked me what is 
the difference between PHP and Java? She also asked me what was need 
of Database in your project and how many tables you had creating in your 
application and for what? I explained this in so much depth and I observed 
big smile on her face which act as a confidence booster for me.  
 
Then She started asking DBMS questions 
1)  ER Model  
2) What is difference between primary Key and Foreign Key  
 
Then We had brief discussion on different technologies which was there in 
my resume. Last question was where do you see yourself in next 5 years  
Lastly, she asked me do you have any question for me. I asked how was 
the work culture at Oracle. She answered Oracle is best place to work, in 
fact best place to start corporate journey as a freshy.   
Those last 2-3 sentences made my day. 
 
Note: - Self Belief  is a key  
 
On the Same Day, result was out & 11 Students got an offer as Associate 
Application Developer and fortunately I was one of them.
